name: empirical-sdd

tools.name: empirical_explore
tools.description: Return read-only Socratic discovery context.

tools.name: empirical_discovery
tools.description: Persist an approved five-pass discovery.

tools.name: empirical_init
tools.description: Initialize or repair repository context after explicit setup consent. activationMode defaults to explicit; automatic requires the team choice.

tools.name: empirical_context
tools.description: Inspect or refresh repository knowledge.

tools.name: empirical_handoff
tools.description: Propose or validate an external-agent handoff.

tools.name: empirical_configure
tools.description: Validate and persist project configuration; reconcile routing artifacts when activationMode is explicitly changed. scope personal writes only this checkout's defaultMode override.

tools.name: empirical_adopt
tools.description: Adopt an Empirical v1 repository non-destructively.

tools.name: empirical_fast
tools.description: Start scoped lightweight work without mandatory tests or formal review; completion is implemented with verification skipped.

tools.name: empirical_complex
tools.description: Start material work; iterative opts into development, feedback iterations and explicit consolidation.

tools.name: empirical_route
tools.description: Select Flow Direct, Flow Delegated, or explicitly requested Formal SDD and report its independent risk floor.

tools.name: empirical_yolo
tools.description: Start or resume work with bounded standing authorization; explicit Fast is limited to the implemented ceiling.

tools.name: empirical_worktree_propose
tools.description: Propose exact safe worktree isolation.

tools.name: empirical_worktree_create
tools.description: Create or recover one explicitly approved worktree, then continue its returned action without another approval. Scope commands and Empirical calls to the target path; defer any host directory switch that would end the turn without automatic continuation.

tools.name: empirical_worktree_prepare
tools.description: Preview or apply local environment file copies for a registered worktree of this repository; after showing the preview paths, apply its token in the same turn.

tools.name: empirical_sync_target
tools.description: Keep the current feature branch current with its target: optionally fetch, then merge the target (never rebase or force) only when the worktree is clean and no conflict is predicted; otherwise change nothing and report the conflicting files. Never pushes.

tools.name: empirical_select
tools.description: Select and resume an existing unclaimed feature in this checkout.

tools.name: empirical_iterate
tools.description: Start an exact-revision adjustment in the same feature without running tests; Fast returns to Implement from Implement or implemented Done (address a Done feature with id), Complex iteration amends its contract in place within the fixed limits (amendContract is the explicit form), and reviseContract reopens the contract through Specify.

tools.name: empirical_direct
tools.description: Pause the selected feature for direct work, resume it by folding the direct diff in as one iteration, or track recent direct Git changes as a Fast or Complex feature; never runs checks.

tools.name: empirical_split_decision
tools.description: Record the answer to the size guardrail for a large Complex feature at the exact revision: keep it as one with a required reason, or split it into independently shippable slices started as separate features; never blocks gates.

tools.name: empirical_consolidate
tools.description: Close the completed Complex iteration and enter the required context, QA, review and integration gates; runs no tests. Fast requires an explicit promote.

tools.name: empirical_promote
tools.description: Promote an exact Fast revision to Complex while preserving its spec, source and immutable history.

tools.name: empirical_transfer
tools.description: Transfer an exact unfinished feature from its source checkout into this registered worktree, preserving original capability bases.

tools.name: empirical_overview
tools.description: Read all registered worktrees and preserved spec copies, owners, progress and diagnostics without selecting or repairing them.

tools.name: empirical_delegation_discover
tools.description: Validate the native host's actual spawn, lookup, status and stop tool capabilities without launching an agent.

tools.name: empirical_delegation_prepare
tools.description: Reserve a bounded authorized native agent assignment for an exact spec revision, role and worker worktree before dispatch.

tools.name: empirical_delegation_accept
tools.description: Accept an exact native agent lifecycle result and reconcile its durable dispatch without fabricating workflow evidence.

tools.name: empirical_delegation_status
tools.description: Read native assignments or prepare an exact observation/cancellation intent; cancellation retains ownership until confirmed.

tools.name: empirical_loop
tools.description: Resume the selected action and retry pending tracker updates.

tools.name: empirical_next
tools.description: Read the exact current action without mutation.

tools.name: empirical_explain
tools.description: Explain deterministic state rationale.

tools.name: empirical_consult
tools.description: Return the required specialist consult packets.

tools.name: empirical_review
tools.description: Prepare or record the exact isolated review result; reviewer credentials resolve only from configured host environment names and are never tool input or output.

tools.name: empirical_review_defer
tools.description: Defer non-blocking findings of the current recorded review to a tracked follow-up with a reason; blocking findings and failed criteria are refused. Runs no checks and changes no source.

tools.name: empirical_tracker_discover
tools.description: Discover accessible tracker targets, workflow metadata, and adapter capabilities. For Linear, first check authenticated sibling MCP tools and prefer the discover/preview/prepare/accept bridge. Legacy policies have a migration candidate from prepare; preserve target, states, ticket rules and enforcement before configure. Never ask for an API key before checking MCP access. OAuth is preferred. If unavailable, use the host-only fallback file at ${XDG_CONFIG_HOME:-$HOME/.config}/empirical/secrets.env on POSIX or %APPDATA%\Empirical\secrets.env on Windows. Never paste credentials into chat; raw credentials are never tool input or output.

tools.name: empirical_tracker_preview
tools.description: Validate and preview one complete effective tracker policy without saving it. For Linear, first check authenticated sibling MCP tools and prefer the discover/preview/prepare/accept bridge. Legacy policies have a migration candidate from prepare; preserve target, states, ticket rules and enforcement before configure. Never ask for an API key before checking MCP access. OAuth is preferred. If unavailable, use the host-only fallback file at ${XDG_CONFIG_HOME:-$HOME/.config}/empirical/secrets.env on POSIX or %APPDATA%\Empirical\secrets.env on Windows. Never paste credentials into chat; raw credentials are never tool input or output.

tools.name: empirical_tracker_suggest
tools.description: Propose the seven-state semantic mapping for one discovered workflow parent. For Linear, first check authenticated sibling MCP tools and prefer the discover/preview/prepare/accept bridge. Legacy policies have a migration candidate from prepare; preserve target, states, ticket rules and enforcement before configure. Never ask for an API key before checking MCP access. OAuth is preferred. If unavailable, use the host-only fallback file at ${XDG_CONFIG_HOME:-$HOME/.config}/empirical/secrets.env on POSIX or %APPDATA%\Empirical\secrets.env on Windows. Never paste credentials into chat; raw credentials are never tool input or output.

tools.name: empirical_tracker_configure
tools.description: Configure or disable the optional external ticket mirror. For Linear, first check authenticated sibling MCP tools and prefer the discover/preview/prepare/accept bridge. Legacy policies have a migration candidate from prepare; preserve target, states, ticket rules and enforcement before configure. Never ask for an API key before checking MCP access. OAuth is preferred. If unavailable, use the host-only fallback file at ${XDG_CONFIG_HOME:-$HOME/.config}/empirical/secrets.env on POSIX or %APPDATA%\Empirical\secrets.env on Windows. Never paste credentials into chat; raw credentials are never tool input or output.

tools.name: empirical_tracker_bind
tools.description: Create or attach the selected feature's external ticket, or attach a terminal feature by explicit id without publishing to it. For Linear, first check authenticated sibling MCP tools and prefer the discover/preview/prepare/accept bridge. Legacy policies have a migration candidate from prepare; preserve target, states, ticket rules and enforcement before configure. Never ask for an API key before checking MCP access. OAuth is preferred. If unavailable, use the host-only fallback file at ${XDG_CONFIG_HOME:-$HOME/.config}/empirical/secrets.env on POSIX or %APPDATA%\Empirical\secrets.env on Windows. Never paste credentials into chat; raw credentials are never tool input or output.

tools.name: empirical_tracker_sync
tools.description: Converge the selected feature's external ticket to committed local state. For Linear, first check authenticated sibling MCP tools and prefer the discover/preview/prepare/accept bridge. Legacy policies have a migration candidate from prepare; preserve target, states, ticket rules and enforcement before configure. Never ask for an API key before checking MCP access. OAuth is preferred. If unavailable, use the host-only fallback file at ${XDG_CONFIG_HOME:-$HOME/.config}/empirical/secrets.env on POSIX or %APPDATA%\Empirical\secrets.env on Windows. Never paste credentials into chat; raw credentials are never tool input or output.

tools.name: empirical_tracker_waive
tools.description: Close a selected or terminal feature's unsynchronized tracker projection as tracked elsewhere or abandoned, with an audited journal record and no provider call.

tools.name: empirical_tracker_linear_mcp_discover
tools.description: Normalize bounded discovery collected through an authenticated Linear MCP connection.

tools.name: empirical_tracker_linear_mcp_preview
tools.description: Preview one Linear MCP tracker policy against its exact submitted discovery.

tools.name: empirical_tracker_linear_mcp_prepare
tools.description: Prepare or resume one durable secret-free Linear MCP tracker intent.

tools.name: empirical_tracker_linear_mcp_accept
tools.description: Validate one normalized Linear MCP result and continue tracker convergence.

tools.name: empirical_tracker_record
tools.description: Record confirmed release or deployment facts from durable evidence for explicitly identified features.

tools.name: empirical_complete
tools.description: Complete the exact current revision.

tools.name: empirical_archive
tools.description: Archive integrated capability projections.

tools.name: empirical_status
tools.description: Read exact workflow and completion state.

tools.name: empirical_verify
tools.description: Validate receipts without advancing state.

tools.name: empirical_qa_plan
tools.description: Generate the exact risk-based verification matrix with its Verify selection (one cheapest command per check, never full CI), or with verificationProfile iterate or final list the commands that profile may execute. Planning never runs tests. An id addresses an implemented Fast Done feature.

tools.name: empirical_qa_execute
tools.description: Execute a matrix-authorized command once for its covered checks, or explicitly reuse an exact valid receipt with reuseReceiptId. Stale reuse fails closed; omit reuseReceiptId to execute again. A fresh full-CI run refuses with FULL_SUITE_APPROVAL_REQUIRED unless the user approved that exact run (at Publish, its publication authorization is the approval). verificationProfile iterate allows only changed-file commands; Fast requires an explicit profile and never runs full CI; an id addresses an implemented Fast Done feature.

tools.name: empirical_qa_start
tools.description: Validate a matrix-authorized command like qa-execute and run it as a background job in a detached snapshot worktree of the committed HEAD; returns immediately with a job id. Refuses a dirty source checkout. One job runs per repository; later starts queue.

tools.name: empirical_qa_status
tools.description: Read background verification jobs: status, elapsed and estimate, receipt id, bounded log tail, and stale when the feature revision or source tree moved since the job started.

tools.name: empirical_qa_cancel
tools.description: Cancel a queued or running background verification job, terminating its worker process tree and removing its snapshot worktree.

tools.name: empirical_qa_approve
tools.description: Record the user's explicit yes to one local full-suite run for the exact revision, command and shown estimate. MCP asks through form elicitation when the host advertises elicitation and records agent-relayed only when it advertises none; the CLI records cli, or cli-unattended with --yes. Never call it without the user's yes. One approval authorizes one run and changes no workflow state.

tools.name: empirical_qa_record
tools.description: Record one explicit human or unavailable QA step without hiding its outcome.

tools.name: empirical_evidence_execute
tools.description: Execute one configured command and record an immutable receipt; an explicit verificationProfile limits which commands may run. An id addresses an implemented Fast Done feature.

tools.name: empirical_evidence_collect
tools.description: Collect immutable artifact evidence. An id addresses an implemented Fast Done feature.

tools.name: empirical_retry
tools.description: Resume a blocked exact revision.

tools.name: empirical_checkpoint
tools.description: Record the user's checkpoint choice to continue past an exceeded budget or restarted verification lap with more minutes; runs no checks.

tools.name: empirical_doctor
tools.description: Diagnose repository state without mutation; every warning and error carries a structured fix.

tools.name: empirical_doctor_fix
tools.description: Preview one plan that resolves Doctor's findings, then apply exactly that plan: safe and confirm fixes run under one digest-bound approval, and each decision runs only the option the user chose. Journals, receipts and credentials are never repaired automatically.

tools.name: empirical_feature_close
tools.description: Close a stuck or externally merged feature, or force-advance exactly one stage past a gate it cannot satisfy, with a recorded reason. It records no completion fact, writes no receipt, and never merges, pushes or publishes.

tools.name: empirical_cleanup
tools.description: Prune the orphans the read-only Doctor report names: dead locks, stale capability claims, prunable worktree registrations, orphan migration scratch and resolved checkout recovery entries. It never touches journals, receipts, specifications, policy or live locks.

tools.name: empirical_reconcile
tools.description: Find unfinished features whose work already merged into the target branch on the forge and, after the user approves the exact previewed plan, close them as merged-externally without selecting each one. Features before Implement, without proven merge evidence, or owned by another live checkout are listed and never closed. It records no completion fact, writes no receipt, and never fetches, merges, pushes or publishes.

tools.name: empirical_migrate
tools.description: Atomically migrate Schema-4 state to Schema 5.

tools.name: empirical_capabilities
tools.description: List or read living capability contracts.

tools.name: empirical_policy
tools.description: Read or validate Policy v2.

tools.name: empirical_feature_finalize
tools.description: Prepare reviewed local feature artifacts before merging its PR, using scoped independent validation without full CI; after committing them, confirm finalization without writing anything. Never merges, pushes, publishes or claims remote delivery.

tools.name: empirical_integrate
tools.description: Replay the Verify selection (never full CI) and integrate against the current target. Route local needs exact full-CI proof (or remote-checks proof for an already pushed commit); route ci leaves full CI to pull-request CI at Deliver. Fast requires explicit promotion.

tools.name: empirical_deliver
tools.description: Deliver through the authorized GitHub ceiling with exact or carried-over local full-CI proof, or required pull-request checks on the exact head; merges nothing before proof. Fast requires explicit promotion.

tools.name: empirical_publish
tools.description: Publish one explicitly authorized immutable version.

tools.name: empirical_integrations
tools.description: Refresh project agent and MCP integrations.

instructions: Use Empirical through its single registry-backed skill. Route deterministically, keep local workflow state authoritative, synchronize Policy v2 after committed progress and execute prepared Linear MCP intents through the granular accept bridge, record immutable evidence receipts, complete exact revisions, and integrate reviewed deltas against an independent target. Bounded standing authorization never suppresses host prompts or weakens Git, credential, publication, or deletion safety floors. Tracker authentication is OAuth-first through negotiated URL-mode elicitation; raw credentials are never valid tool input or output and must never be pasted into chat.
